name: Administrator creates linked academic structure
description: Creates linked academic records and verifies they remain available after refresh.
steps: Sign in as an Administrator or Super Admin
Create a faculty, department, programme and course in sequence
Refresh the module and verify the records remain listed
expected: All linked academic records remain visible after refresh; invalid parent references are rejected.

name: Student scans a session QR and submits attendance for review
description: Verifies the active session QR can be read by a supported mobile browser and creates a pending attendance record.
steps: Sign in as a Lecturer and create a live attendance session
Sign in as a Student on a supported mobile browser and open Check in
Scan the QR code and submit the captured code
expected: The student receives a pending verification confirmation and cannot submit a second check-in for the same session.

name: Lecturer verifies or rejects attendance only for own sessions
description: Verifies a lecturer can make a single review decision for pending records belonging to their own sessions.
steps: Verify a pending record from a session they created
Attempt to review a record from another lecturer's session
expected: The owned record changes to Verified or Rejected; another lecturer's record is denied and reviewed records cannot be changed again.

name: Students can view only their enrolled timetable
description: Verifies the timetable view is scoped to the authenticated student's active course enrollments.
steps: Sign in as a Student with one active course enrollment
expected: Only timetable entries for courses in the student's active enrollments are shown.

name: Academic administration is read-only for students and invalid decisions are rejected
description: Verifies student writes are denied and attendance records cannot be moved into unsupported review states.
steps: Sign in as a Student and attempt to access attendance review
Attempt to submit an invalid attendance decision
expected: Students cannot review attendance and only Verified or Rejected decisions are accepted for pending records.
